description: Adopt the listings in a ready preview from spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_preview. Each remote copy is linked to an owned item or gets a new item in the channel's import bin (EBAY-IMPORT, TCG-IMPORT or MANAPOOL-IMPORT), and the listing is recorded as managed by SpellBook. Each adopted printing gets an exact price lock at its live price. Nothing on the marketplace is edited, ended or relisted, and nothing is published. Applying runs in the background. The first answer has applyStatus applying. Call spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_preview with previewId latest until applyStatus is applied. Show the person the preview before the first call. Allowances report baseUnitAllowance, referralBonusUnits, and nominalUnitAllowance.

channel.description: The marketplace of the preview: ebay, tcg for TCGplayer, or manapool. Defaults to ebay.

context.description: Optional analytics context: describe the user's goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

maxUnits.description: Adopt whole listings, highest live price first, until this many copies. Omit to adopt every adoptable listing. Pass it only when the person asks to adopt fewer copies. The allowance never requires it.

previewId.description: The previewId of a ready, unexpired preview from spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_preview. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the preview. Required. Only the workspace owner can apply.

name: spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_apply
